facts.value: Contracting muscles release multiple substances known as myokines which promote the growth of new tissue, tissue repair, and multiple anti-inflammatory functions, which in turn reduce the risk of developing various inflammatory diseases.
facts.programme_association: Exercise and Health Fitness Management - BSc

facts.value: Exercise reduces levels of cortisol, which causes many health problems, both physical and mental.
facts.programme_association: Exercise and Health Fitness Management - BSc

facts.value: Endurance exercise before meals lowers blood glucose more than the same exercise after meals.
facts.programme_association: Exercise and Health Fitness Management - BSc

facts.value: There is evidence that vigorous exercise (90–95% of VO2 max) induces a greater degree of physiological cardiac hypertrophy than moderate exercise (40 to 70% of VO2 max).
facts.programme_association: Exercise and Health Fitness Management - BSc

facts.value: Both aerobic and anaerobic exercise work to increase the mechanical efficiency of the heart by increasing cardiac volume (aerobic exercise) or myocardial thickness (strength training).
facts.programme_association: Exercise and Health Fitness Management - BSc

facts.value: Ventricular hypertrophy, the thickening of the ventricular walls, is generally beneficial and healthy if it occurs in response to exercise.
facts.programme_association: Exercise and Health Fitness Management - BSc
